# 20 — Tooling, generated files, CI

## `harness/pyproject.toml` (derived, hand-maintained)

```toml
[project]
name = "shackles-harness"
version = "0"                      # never bumped; the harness is not packaged
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pyyaml>=6"]
[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest>=8"]
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
addopts = "-q -m 'not probe'"
markers = ["probe: live agent probe; opt-in, costs money"]
```

No build backend, no install step: `python src/run.py` runs in place and tests use
`pythonpath = ["src"]`. The verify command run by the runner (`verifyCommand`) is the
same `python -m pytest`, so `addopts` excludes probes there too.

## `<repo>/.gitignore` (derived; `install` appends missing required lines)

```
.worktrees/
harness/OWNER.log
__pycache__/
.pytest_cache/
```

`local.yaml`, `.claude/`, `CLAUDE.md`, `INDEX.md` and `archives/` are committed.

## `harness/.claude/settings.json` (generated by `install`)

```json
{"hooks": {"UserPromptSubmit": [{"hooks": [{"type": "command",
  "command": "python \"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/src/hooks/owner_log_hook.py\""}]}]}}
```

`install --python EXE` substitutes the interpreter; other keys already in the file
are preserved. The owner starts the Claude Code session at `harness/` so this
project-level settings file and `.claude/agents/` are loaded [JC-42].

## `harness/.claude/agents/*.md` (generated by `install`)

One `<rung>.md` and one `<rung>-gate.md` per key of `subAgents.yaml` (file 14).
`local.yaml` records the hash of `subAgents.yaml` they were generated from; a mismatch
makes `doctor` report an error and `start`/`next` refuse until `install` runs and the
session restarts.

## `harness/CLAUDE.md` (generated once by `install`)

Exactly `@AGENTS.md`, so Claude Code loads the owner's AGENTS.md as the project
instructions without a symlink [JC-03]. Never overwritten if it exists.

## `<repo>/.github/workflows/ci.yml` (derived, optional) [JC-02]

```yaml
name: ci
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: "3.12"}
      - run: pip install pyyaml pytest
      - run: git config --global user.email ci@example.invalid && git config --global user.name ci
      - run: cd harness && python -m pytest
```

The drift test runs in CI, so an unaccepted spec edit fails CI until the owner runs
`spec accept` and commits `local.yaml` and `archives/spec-baseline/`. Probes never run
in CI.

## Scripts

None beyond `src/run.py` and the hook. Everything an agent or the owner does is a
`run.py` subcommand, which keeps the surface AGENTS.md describes (`next`, `record`,
`src/run.py`) the only one.

## Environment variables the harness reads

- `SHACKLES_VERIFY=1` — set by `verify.run` for the suite it runs (tests may skip
  network or probes under it).
- `SHACKLES_PROBES=1` — required by probe tests in addition to `-m probe`.
- `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` — used only inside the generated hook command.
- `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` — set by `gitops` for every git call.
